name: Fine-Grained Bug Localization Benchmark
description: Evaluates models that rank and map textual bug reports to the relevant source files in a codebase.
evaluation_method: Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) / top-k accuracy (e.g., top-1, top-5)
reputation: Well-cited in software engineering research as a standard dataset for evaluating bug localization techniques.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark tied to real codebases; relatively small/older dataset in some variants; results can be sensitive to codebase preprocessing and may be affected if models were pre-trained on public code (contamination risk).
